T0539.title: Lock File
T0539.definition: A file that records exact dependency versions and integrity metadata to make builds repeatable.
T0539.description: Lock files record exact dependency versions and integrity hashes, reducing dependency drift and unexpected upgrades during builds. Missing or uncommitted lock files make builds depend on external repository state and increase exposure to malicious replacement and irreproducibility. Controls focus on mandatory lock files, review of lock-file changes, and planned update cycles.
T0539.usageExample: Assess Lock File related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
